description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/02186/LBC: drawings and finishes (3) and columns, beams, stairs and railings (4) in respect of installation of a new mezzanine floor within approximately half of the prayer hall area.
decision_conditions: Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate compliance with the stated Conditions (3) and (4).  It is held that the submitted details fail to accord with policy requirements in line with the Council's adopted standards to ensure that details of columns, finishes and stairs are implemented to acceptable standards within the development to preserve the character of the heritage asset. It is therefore considered that the submission fails to comply with policies DMD44 of the Development Management Document (2014), CP31 of the Core Strategy (2010), HC1 of the London Plan (2021) as well as the advice contained within the NPPF (2024).
